title: Lattice Filter - Band 66 (AWS) for 4G LTE Carrier Aggregation
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Pierre Dubois

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Lattice Filter filter targeting Band 66 (AWS) for 4G LTE Carrier Aggregation. The filter is designed on PZT on Si substrate with a target center frequency of 2847.6 MHz and bandwidth of 163.3 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the 4G LTE Carrier Aggregation module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Lattice Filter
- Frequency Band: Band 66 (AWS)
- Application: 4G LTE Carrier Aggregation
- Substrate: PZT on Si
- Package: CSP (Chip Scale Package)
- Design Tool: PathWave EM Design
- Design Center: San Jose Advanced Design Lab

This specification applies to all variants of the Lattice Filter design targeting Band 66 (AWS). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2847.6 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       163.3 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.6 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 13.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 47.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 22.0 dB
Q Factor:               4570
Temperature Coefficient:-21.2 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.4 x 1.3 mm
Wafer Size:             8-inch
Number of Resonators:   3
Electrode Material:     Pt/Al
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open PathWave EM Design and load the Lattice Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: PZT on Si with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2847.6 MHz, BW 163.3 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.6 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (CSP (Chip Scale Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (8-inch, PZT on Si).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N5227B PNA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 8543 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.6 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 13.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 245 MHz offset >= 47.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 9 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 7.5 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +32 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 89%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-09-25
Devices Tested:         28
Insertion Loss (meas):  2.33 dB
Return Loss (meas):     15.0 dB
Rejection (meas):       49.7 dB
Isolation (meas):       27.0 dB
Q Factor (meas):        4570
Group Delay Variation:  7.7 ns
Power Handling:         +33 dBm
Die Yield:              84.3%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Lattice Filter design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 66 (AWS).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Slight frequency drift observed at +85°C; TC layer thickness may need adjustment.
e) Cross-talk between adjacent filter channels was below -55 dB.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
